example_metadata.name: Portfolio - Liquid Assets
example_metadata.purpose: Canonical Portfolio fixture showing supported liquid assets detected directly in a connected wallet.
notes: This is synthetic fixture data, not real user wallet data.
Production balances and classifications must come from wallet/on-chain/product data.
Liquid Assets are read-only in MVP and do not imply WealthSmith controls funds.

scenario.description: Connected wallet has supported liquid SOL, BONK, and USDC balances. No staking or yield strategy positions are included in this specific fixture.
expected_behavior: Show values and allocation percentages from provided data.
Do not show protocol manage links for liquid wallet balances.
Do not imply WealthSmith can move or manage these assets.

section.title: Liquid Assets
section.description: Supported tokens held directly in your connected wallet.

hard_rules: Do not show Manage link for plain liquid wallet balance.
Do not imply WealthSmith can stake or move SOL from this table.
Do not shame meme-token exposure in the portfolio table.
Risk-alignment suggestions belong in Suggestions, not this table.
Do not describe USDC as risk-free.
Safety Buffer calculations belong to Safety Buffer logic, not this table.

asset_deployment_overview.title: Asset Deployment Overview
asset_deployment_overview.production_rule: Production deployment classification must come from portfolio classification logic.

copy.section_description: Supported tokens held directly in your connected wallet.
copy.empty_description: WealthSmith did not find supported liquid assets in this wallet.
copy.partial_data_description: WealthSmith loaded part of your portfolio, but some liquid assets could not be checked.
copy.error_description: Try again in a moment. Your funds stay in your wallet.

smith_ai_context.approved_response: Liquid Assets are supported tokens held directly in your connected wallet and not currently shown as staked assets or yield strategy positions. WealthSmith reads this data to show your portfolio, but it does not move funds from your wallet.

rules: Do not use Smith AI animation for portfolio table loading.

empty.title: No liquid assets found
empty.description: WealthSmith did not find supported liquid assets in this wallet.
rules: Use only when wallet data loaded successfully and no supported liquid assets are found.
Do not say wallet is empty if unsupported assets may exist.

error.title: We couldn’t load liquid assets
error.description: Try again in a moment. Your funds stay in your wallet.
rules: Do not imply funds are affected.

partial.title: Some liquid assets are unavailable
partial.description: WealthSmith loaded part of your portfolio, but some liquid assets could not be checked.
rules: Do not hide partial data behind a full-page error.

qa_assertions.assertion: Liquid Assets table is visible when data is ready.
SOL, BONK, and USDC use approved token icons.
Total liquid assets equals sum of SOL, BONK, and USDC values.
Plain liquid wallet balances do not show Manage protocol links.
Liquid Assets copy does not imply WealthSmith controls or moves funds.
Loading/error/empty states do not show fake balances.

hard_rules: This fixture is not production data.
Production liquid assets must come from wallet/on-chain/product data.
Do not invent balances, prices, token classifications, or icons.
Do not show protocol Manage links for plain liquid wallet balances.
Do not imply WealthSmith holds, controls, moves, swaps, stakes, deposits, or withdraws assets.
Do not describe stablecoins as risk-free.
Do not ask for seed phrases, private keys, passwords, or wallet backup files.
Use fallback token icon only when an approved token icon is unavailable.
Keep Liquid Assets separate from Staked Assets and Yield Strategies.
